sessions.name: project-hook-smoke
sessions.prompt: This is a fresh Project session for a narrow observability smoke test. Run `python3 tools/projectctl.py context` exactly once. Then run `sed -n '1,12p' README.md` exactly once as the only Markdown content read, and run `git diff -- README.md` exactly once as a non-content check. Do not edit files, do not inspect any other Markdown file, do not use a Skill or subagent, and stop after reporting whether both commands succeeded.
